name: Proxima Centauri
description: A small, low-mass star located 4.2465 light-years away from the Sun in the southern constellation of Centaurus.

name: Betelgeuse
description: A red supergiant of spectral type M1-2 and one of the largest visible stars to the naked eye.

name: Kepler-186f
description: An exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf Kepler-186, about 580 light-years from Earth. It is the first planet with a radius similar to Earth's.

name: Orion Nebula
description: A diffuse nebula situated in the Milky Way, being south of Orion's Belt in the constellation of Orion.

name: Sirius A
description: The brightest star in the night sky. Sirius A is part of the binary star system Sirius, and it is the larger and more luminous of the two.
